description: Search federal funding opportunities on Grants.gov (keyless). Filter by keyword, opportunity status (forecasted/posted/closed/archived), agency, funding category and eligibility. Returns opportunity number, title, agency, status, open/close dates and CFDA numbers.

eligibilities.description: Applicant-eligibility code filter (e.g. '25' state governments, '99' unrestricted). Pipe-separate multiples.

fundingCategories.description: Funding category code filter (e.g. 'ENV', 'ED'). Pipe-separate multiples.

fundingInstruments.description: Funding-instrument code filter (e.g. 'G' grant, 'CA' cooperative agreement). Pipe-separate multiples.

oppStatuses.description: Pipe-separated statuses. Default 'forecasted|posted'. Options: forecasted, posted, closed, archived.

name: grants_search
